_meta.uncertain_marker: Any value or text containing '?' is not confirmed by a reliable source.

xp_per_round_formula.description: Base XP awarded at the END of each completed round r. Fixed per round: independent of pops/damage. Same base amount for player XP, tower XP and hero XP.
xp_per_round_formula.final_formula: tower_xp_round = base(r) * map_difficulty_mult * (1.08 if Monkey Education else 1) * freeplay_mult(r)

split_rule.rule: At each round end, that round's tower XP is split between TOWER TYPES in proportion to the cash currently invested (purchase + upgrades) in that type's towers on the map. Each share goes into the type's single account-wide XP pool, from which upgrades are unlocked.
split_rule.formula: xp_to_type[T] = tower_xp_round * invested_cash[T] / sum(invested_cash of all non-hero towers on map)
split_rule.heroes: Cash spent on heroes is ignored. Hero XP is a separate stream that is not split with towers (it is split evenly only between several heroes, e.g. co-op).
split_rule.upgraded_vs_unupgraded: No flat per-tower amount. A tier-5 earns more than a bare tower only because more cash is invested in it. Only the ratio matters: a lone $200 target tower with no other non-hero towers on the map receives 100% of the round's tower XP.
split_rule.tower_count: Irrelevant; many cheap towers give no advantage over one expensive tower of the same type.
split_rule.sold_towers: Get nothing (no invested cash at round end). Towers placed mid-round count if still on the map at round end.
split_rule.invested_cash_definition: Price actually paid (difficulty-scaled, discounted) vs. sell value vs. base price: unknown ?. It does not matter when only one type is on the map.
split_rule.insta_monkeys_paragons_subtowers: How free Insta Monkeys, Paragons, and sub-towers count toward invested cash: unknown ?
split_rule.coop: Split first between players by their invested-cash ratio, then per type within each player.

difficulty_multipliers._note: Sources list no XP multiplier for game difficulty; harder difficulties give more XP only because they include more and later rounds. Tower prices (Easy x0.85, Hard x1.08, Impoppable ~x1.2) do not affect the ratio split. Values are 1.0 by absence of evidence ?

map_difficulty_multipliers.map_editor_maps: count as intermediate for hero XP; tower XP assumed the same ?

mode_multipliers._note: No mode-specific XP multiplier was found. Modes differ only in which rounds are played (see mode_round_ranges). 1.0 values mean no evidence of any multiplier ?
mode_multipliers.double_cash_mode: 1.0: doubles cash only, so the ratio split is unaffected ?
mode_multipliers.fast_track_mode: The first 25% of rounds are skipped and earn no XP (Hard starts r22, Impoppable r29). No other multiplier ?. Not usable in CHIMPS or Deflation.
mode_multipliers.sandbox_note: No rewards, stats or achievements; heroes explicitly gain no round XP. Tower and player XP assumed 0 ?
mode_multipliers.coop: Each player earns the same player XP as in singleplayer; tower XP is split by invested cash.

freeplay_multiplier.rule: Applies to rounds played after the mode's win round (continuing into freeplay).
freeplay_multiplier.impoppable_chimps: These win at r100, so every freeplay round uses 0.10.
freeplay_multiplier.applies_to: player XP and tower XP; hero XP ? (the community hero calculator does not apply it)
freeplay_multiplier.history: v24.0 changed the freeplay entry reduction from 90% to 70%; rounds after 100 were unchanged.

monkey_education.effect: +8% tower XP and hero XP at round end (Support tree, free, needs 3 points invested)

monkey_knowledge.monkeys_together_strong: +5% hero XP per hero on the map (heroes only)

excess_xp.rule: After all 15 upgrades are unlocked, tower XP keeps accumulating. It is needed for the Paragon unlock, which costs XP on top of all 15 upgrades. After the paragon, or for towers without one, extra XP has no known use ?

paragon.unlock: Tower XP only, no Monkey Money. Requires all 15 regular upgrades of the tower to be unlocked first, then the paragon's own XP cost.
paragon.build_requirements: All three tier-5s of the tower on the map at the same time, then pay the cash cost (scaled by difficulty; the table lists the Medium price). Only one of each paragon at a time. In Sandbox it is available only after building it once in a real game.

degree_power_sources_v57.cash: absorbed non-T5 towers: 1 power per (paragon_cost/20000) dollars spent; slider: 1 per (paragon_cost*1.05/20000) dollars; cap 80,000
degree_power_sources_v57.extra_tier5s: 6,000 per tier-5 beyond the first three; cap 50,000
degree_power_sources_v57.damage_income: 1 power per 180 damage dealt or per $45 earned by absorbed towers; cap 125,000

apopalypse.note: random rounds, no breaks between rounds; win round 60 since v3.0

impoppable.note: Impoppable is its own difficulty in BTD6 (starts r6, ends r100)

notes: XP belongs to the tower TYPE (account-wide pool), not to an individual tower.
To grind type T, keep T at about 100% of non-hero invested cash at every round end. Other types, including Banana Farms, take XP in proportion to their cash.
To feed two targets, balance invested cash between them.

Later rounds give much more XP (r10 = 220, r50 = 1620, r100 = 6120). Full-game base totals: Easy 21,400, Medium 56,950, Deflation 45,950, Hard 126,150, CHIMPS/Impoppable 231,150; multiply by map difficulty.
Freeplay is penalised (x0.3, then x0.1 after r100), so the bot should usually stop at the win round. Compare XP per minute, not per game.
Upgrade XP numbers were parsed from https://www.bloonswiki.com/List_of_upgrades_in_BTD6. Dart Monkey tier-1 upgrades are unlocked by default (0 XP). Cash costs are Medium prices.
